title: IdentityContext
description: The verified identity a service acts on. A service derives it from validated credentials (see docs/style-guide.md#identity); it is never accepted from a request body or an unverified header.

subjectId.description: The token's `sub` (end user) or workload client ID, unique within `issuer`.

organizationId.description: Tenant. Mapped server-side from the trusted issuer/client binding, never from a caller claim the service did not configure.

delegation.description: Present when a workload acts for a verified end user: the subject is the user and `actor` is the workload. See ADR-0003.
